problem_type: View state invalidates content revisions and reversible adoption receipts
symptom: Real Electron toolbar adoption appends the image at frame 60, but auto-fit changes scale and immediately removes the success/Undo receipt.
direct_cause: timelineRevision hashes normalized scale and playheadFrame; proposalIsLanded compares the applied content revision after TimelinePanel auto-fit changes scale.
class_root: The shared timeline content revision does not distinguish editing facts from view state.
affected_population: Single-node and batch adoption receipts after zoom or playback
Agent timeline plans and export compare-and-swap checks during view-only changes
entry_points: adoptStoryboardBatch and Agent timeline edits/export share the kernel revision
internal_only_reason: The invariant is Nomi timeline domain state ownership; installed source and the real Electron failure determine the behavior.
invariants: Scale and playhead changes cannot alter timeline content revision.
Tracks, source windows, audio, captions, transitions, fps and export content continue to invalidate revisions.
Undo remains invalid after an intervening content edit, preventing unrelated edits from being undone.
View-only store ticks must not rehash all timeline contents in live Undo receipt subscriptions.

door_reduction.why_not: Each adoption, receipt, Agent plan and export reader must still compare content at its own transaction boundary. adoptionProposalKey delegates to the kernel; changing the kernel projection enforces one shared revision for every caller without removing legitimate operations. The content projection adds explicit subscription doors for adoption and Agent receipts; these must observe their own Undo validity and share the kernel projection instead of rehashing on playback.

generality_proof: Every enumerated consumer calls timelineRevision directly or through timelineRevisionOf. One projection in the kernel excludes only scale/playheadFrame, while hashing all remaining normalized content. Thus auto-fit, manual zoom and playback cannot invalidate receipts or Agent edits; actual content still does.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Canonical content revision shared by adoption, Agent edits and export.
Same view-free projection drives hash and shallow receipt subscriptions, preserving nested text/framing scale.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Applied revision guards live receipt validity and safe Undo.
Read/apply/commit compare the same shared timelineRevision.
Expected content revision must survive view-only changes, while rendered-content edits remain stale.

recurrence.reason: Any adopted media that changes duration can auto-fit; manual zoom/playback reaches the same revision guard across single/batch adoption and Agent operations.
same_class_scan: Inspected adoptionProposalRegistry, adoptionReceipt, timelineCapabilityTarget, exportToolCall and TimelinePanel auto-fit path.

prevention.invariant: Content revision excludes view state at its sole canonical producer.
prevention.failure_mode: Actual content changes continue to fail expected-revision and receipt validity guards.
prevention.strategy: Project normalized view properties out before hashing; retain the shared protocol, never special-case auto-fit or callers. Receipt subscriptions shallow-compare that same content projection before invoking the full validity guard; playback does not repeatedly hash the timeline.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace the existing revision projection in place; no second protocol or fallback.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal domain-state projection, no third-party behavior change.

migration: Revisions/proposals are local ephemeral comparisons; restarted sessions generate the new canonical content revision. Persisted timeline view state remains intact.
residual_risks: Packaged app and Windows remain unverified.
Live provider or paid-generation workflows are outside this toolbar migration.
